what: The welcome screen of the app on a first start, before any folder is read.
alt: The Bowerloom welcome screen. It says that Bowerloom only reads, and shows a Find my files button.
caption: The welcome screen says that Bowerloom only reads. Press Find my files to start.

what: The list of engine files that the app found, each source ticked, with its count.
alt: A list of the sources the app found, each with a tick box and a count of files, and a Looks right button.
caption: The app lists what it found. Untick a source to skip it.

what: The Install history screen with its Undo rows.
alt: The Install history screen in the app, with the list of changes.
caption: Install history lists each change, newest first.

section: Make a harness from a folder
what: The New harness from a folder sheet at its review step.
alt: The New harness from a folder sheet, showing the files it read and the approvals to tick.
caption: The review step shows what the app read before it writes anything.

what: The install review for both engines, each part with its result.
alt: The install review sheet. Each part shows a dot and one of the words Exact, Translated, Weakened, or Absent.
caption: The install review marks each part as Exact, Translated, Weakened, or Absent.

what: The Builder graph with a skill linked to an agent and one unsaved change.
alt: The Builder graph. Agents sit on the left, skills on the right, and a line joins a skill to an agent.
caption: The Builder shows agents on the left and skills on the right.

what: The Save review sheet that lists each file the save changes.
alt: The Save review sheet with two changed files listed and a Save 2 files button.
caption: The save review lists each file that the save changes.

section: Save points, Go back, and Set aside
what: The Save points list with one row marked Now.
alt: The Save points list. Each row shows its number, what changed, its time, and its file count.
caption: Each save point is a copy of the harness as it was.

what: The Import sheet after a file is chosen.
alt: The Import sheet, showing what the chosen file holds and the boxes to tick.
caption: The import sheet shows what the file holds before it writes.

what: The Overview graph of every place the first read found.
alt: The Overview screen, a graph of folders with their agents, skills, and tools.
caption: The Overview shows every place the app found in one graph.

what: The Engines screen with the health and the switch of each engine.
alt: The Engines screen, with one row for each engine and a switch on each row.
caption: The Engines screen shows the health of each engine and its switch.

what: The Export sheet of the Builder before the file is written.
alt: The Export sheet, showing the files the harness file will hold.
caption: The export sheet shows what the file will hold.

what: The tour at the step that builds the Notes keeper.
alt: The Notes keeper build sheet with the guided tour open at step 4 of 7.
caption: The tour walks through the build of the Notes keeper.

what: The Help screen of the app.
alt: The Help screen of the app.
caption: The Help screen has the report and usage log entries.

what: bowerloom --help
alt: The short help of the command line.
caption: The short help lists the commands you use first.

what: bowerloom up --team first --goal ... (plan only)
alt: The plan that bowerloom up prints.
caption: Up prints a plan and a revision, and writes nothing until you approve.

what: bowerloom ls after up
alt: What the project holds.
caption: The list shows the teams, skills, prompts, and slices of the project.

what: bowerloom skill create house-style (plan only)
alt: The plan that skill create prints.
caption: Each create command prints its plan first.

what: bowerloom status
alt: The status of a project.
caption: Status says whether the project is ready.

what: bowerloom init plan
alt: The plan for a new project.
caption: The plan lists the files before any is written.

what: bowerloom harness status on a folder with no harness
alt: The harness status of a folder with no harness.
caption: Status changes nothing and names the next step.

what: bowerloom harness adopt (plan only)
alt: The adopt plan.
caption: The adopt plan lists the files it writes into .bowerloom.

what: bowerloom harness install (plan only)
alt: The install plan.
caption: The install plan lists each file it changes.

what: bowerloom harness drift after an install
alt: The drift check after an install.
caption: Drift confirms that every written file is as written.

what: bowerloom harness remove (plan only)
alt: The removal plan.
caption: Remove prints its own plan before it undoes the install.

what: bowerloom harness export (plan only)
alt: The export plan.
caption: The export plan says what the file will hold.

what: bowerloom harness import (plan only)
alt: The import plan.
caption: The import plan says what the file would write.

what: bowerloom apply after a prompt is created (plan only)
alt: The plan that bowerloom apply prints.
caption: Apply prints a plan of the copies it will put in place.
